citations.claim: body 0 accelerated to 2.1 m/s in one step under excessive controller force
controller work/energy recorded, force was 105.533 exceeding fmax 81.179 at step 1 (violation)
initial position far from waypoint 16.5,3.6 requiring large velocity command

counterfactual.change: Increased fmax from 81.179 to 200 with all other fields identical; force 105 now within limit, so no violation. Proves controller force calculation itself exceeds declared limit and is not clamped.

explanation: Controller force is computed as kp * velocity-error toward waypoint plus noise, but not clamped to fmax. In shrunk case kp=28.6, vcmd=4.4, distance to waypoint demands large velocity change from zero, so kp*error ≈105 N, exceeding declared fmax 81.18 N. Increasing fmax to 200 removes violation, confirming the limiter is missing/broken.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body starts at the top of the arena far from the green waypoint near the bottom right. From step 0 to step 1 it shows almost no displacement, yet it is already flagged for controller_force_limit, indicating the commanded force is excessive from rest.
